i1.title: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Noir Intense Eau de Toilette 100ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Cool watermelon and basil over a dark chocolate base.

Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Noir Intense Eau de Toilette 100ml is an aromatic fougère fragrance for men from the Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 polo-shirt collection, launched in 2013. Juicy watermelon and green basil open it cool and fresh, a heart of lavender and verbena adds an aromatic, clean lift, and it dries down to a warm, unexpected base of dark chocolate, cashmeran and patchouli.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Watermelon, Basil
  • Heart: Lavender, Verbena
  • Base: Dark Chocolate, Cashmeran, Patchouli

Key details

  • Brand: Lacoste
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Aromatic · Fougère · Gourmand
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • A cool watermelon and basil opening
  • An aromatic lavender and verbena heart
  • A warm dark chocolate, cashmeran and patchouli base
  • Generous 100ml Eau de Toilette

FAQ

What does L.12.12 Noir Intense smell like?

Watermelon and basil first, then lavender and verbena, finishing with dark chocolate, cashmeran and patchouli.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance.
